_about: Fixed URL set for the speed plan (docs/speed-plan.md, SP00). pages: what measure.py times; expect is text a page holds only when its data rendered. api: the GET reads the player and team pages make, as captured by capture_reads.py. snapshot: every read behind the pages, for snapshot.py; {releaseId}, {season} and {beforeDate} are the target's release and default scope. static (SP06): one file of each kind the pages load, for their cache headers; origin api means the API origin.
